text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out with Matikanetannhauser, when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Bourbon and Rice. Hey there!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, hello... What a coincidence. Are
you two
going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup, gotta take breaks sometimes. What
are you
two up to?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well... Bourbon won these special
Bubble Land
tickets, and she wanted me
to go with her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission number one, "Win a Prize," is
complete.
I'm currently executing
mission number two,
"Bring Rice to
Bubble Land."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you... You're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Expression of gratitude confirmed.
Searching for
appropriate response...
You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-anyway! See you later, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, those two are such great friends.
That sure
sounds like a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we also go to Bubble
Land? I
mean, the two of us are great
friends too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Great! Then, it's off to Bubble Land!
Let's go, go,
go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many people here.
And yet...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I forgot my swimsuit! Ughhh, my bubbly
dreams
have been popped!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not only did you get me a swimsuit, you
bought
me this flappy fan too?! Thank
you so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! ♪ This is the bubbly best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's almost time for the parade... I
really,
really want to see it, but... I
danced so much that
now I'm sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... wheeze... We finally made it! This waterslide sure is high!
choice_data_list: パレードは動画に録っておこう

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But all that hard work is about to pay off
on the
way d—oh... My nose feels
funny...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me I'm getting a nosebleed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My frenetic day with
Matikanetannhauser
practically flies by.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, man, Bubble Land is so much fun.
I'm so
happy we came here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look over there!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching... Searching... I've confirmed
that Rice
is approaching.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for the wait! Um, uh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to give you this...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Body temperature and heart rate rising
in
response to unforeseen event...
Actually, I bought
you a drink as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Really? You didn't need to get anything
for me...
B-but thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy that you've accepted it...
Mission
complete.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm happy too. Hehe, we're really
on the
same page.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You can see how much they care about
each
other... Yep, yep, that's some
high-level respect.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I have to follow their lead and never
forget to be
considerate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. Come to think of it, you're always
doing so
much for me, but I feel like I
never give anything
back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I am worried! Our relationship should
go both
ways!
choice_data_list: レースの結果で返してほしい！

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's it, I'm gonna go buy you
something tasty!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! There are so many people... I-I'm
being
swept away by the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah! Where are you taking me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rescue Matikanetannhauser from her

predicament, and we're both left
thoroughly
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can handle that! I'll win and stir up a
storm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... If I'm going to do that, we've
also got to
raise the quality of my
training. What should we
do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And what kind of race should I run
in? I'll
have to consider my schedule...
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. You're just doing everything for
me again!
choice_data_list: スケジュールを組んでおくよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser seems at a loss as
to how to
repay me for all the things I
do for her.
